Arslan-tober 2026: Tiny Tales

Series Metadata

Creator:
KayleySayer
Series Begun:
2026-10-01
Series Updated:
2026-10-31
Description:

A collection of Arslan Senki drabbles and ficlets written from prompts submitted through Tumblr for Arslan-tober 2026.

The original prompt list had 31 options; how many of them actually turn into stories depends entirely on what lands in my ask box.

Expect anything from exactly 100-word drabbles to short ficlets of up to roughly 1,000 words — humour, character moments, angst, court gossip, friendship, ghosts, and whatever other chaos the prompt combinations decide to cause.

Notes:

This little project was inspired by @importantdestinydefender’s Inktober, where people could send in character + prompt combinations. Since there was absolutely no chance of me completing an actual drawing challenge — I am still working on Kaleiya’s character sheets. Since March. — I stole the general idea and turned it into writing instead.

The original Tumblr prompt list contains 31 prompts. People can send me a character + prompt number, and are very welcome to add their own scenario, relationship, setting, or oddly specific detail if they already have something in mind.

Prompts and characters may repeat; I’ll only avoid repeating the exact same character + prompt combination.

Each story stands on its own unless stated otherwise, so timeline, tone, and supporting characters may vary from piece to piece.

    Time to see his brother grow, time to fulfil his responsibilities, and perhaps, one day, time for a life beyond them.

    Death had put an end to those expectations.

    But when Kubard finds him on the shores of a river neither man understands, they must confront what they lost, what they left behind, and what might still await them on the farther shore.
